candidates.en: We have learned that we are born to process and produce natural human language by looking at what we are exposed to, or what we create with the universal grammar principles that we are born with.
candidates.zh: 我们了解到，人天生具有加工和生成自然人类语言的能力：既可以从接触到的语言中学习，也能凭借与生俱来的普遍语法原则创造语言。

zh: 我们了解到，人天生具有加工和生成自然人类语言的能力：既可以从接触到的语言中学习，
也能凭借与生俱来的普遍语法原则创造语言。

candidates.en: So the language mechanism in the brain has already had certain linguistic parameters set, such as word order in the first language, and that makes second language learning quite different.
candidates.zh: 因此，大脑中的语言机制已经设定了某些语言参数，例如第一语言的语序，这使第二语言的学习大不相同。

candidates.en: In second language learning, the first language tends to serve as a model, and mistakes often result from taking words from the target language and putting them together, because learners tend to apply rules from the first language.
candidates.zh: 学习第二语言时，第一语言往往会成为范本；学习者取用目标语中的词，再按第一语言的规则将它们组合起来，就常常会犯错。

zh: 学习第二语言时，第一语言往往会成为范本；
学习者取用目标语中的词，再按第一语言的规则将它们组合起来，就常常会犯错。

candidates.en: However, second language learning, especially in a classroom setting, proceeds more quickly with adults and adolescents than with younger children initially, although at the end of the day, it is the younger child who will become more proficient in second language learning than grownups.
candidates.zh: 不过，在第二语言学习中，特别是在课堂环境下，成年人和青少年起初比年幼儿童学得更快；但最终，年幼儿童的第二语言水平会比成年人更熟练。

zh: 不过，在第二语言学习中，特别是在课堂环境下，
成年人和青少年起初比年幼儿童学得更快；但最终，
年幼儿童的第二语言水平会比成年人更熟练。

candidates.en: Numerous studies have shown that a number of traits, such as self-confidence, motivation, good self-image and low anxiety, can facilitate second language learning, but none of these traits seem as important to first language acquisition.
candidates.zh: 大量研究表明，自信、动机、良好的自我形象和较低的焦虑等特质，有助于第二语言学习；但这些特质对于第一语言习得，似乎都没有那么重要。

zh: 大量研究表明，自信、动机、良好的自我形象和较低的焦虑等特质，
有助于第二语言学习；但这些特质对于第一语言习得，似乎都没有那么重要。

candidates.en: If a second language learner has a classroom teacher who talks in the target language at a quick rate, in complex sentences and about complicated matters, the learner will probably have a harder time in the learning process.
